article.story: HIGH POINT, N.C. -- — Jason Rivera-Torres and Isaac Garrett scored 16 points apiece as High Point beat Montana State 85-74 on Thursday. Rivera-Torres had six rebounds and three blocks for the Panthers (6-0). Garrett added six rebounds and three steals. Curtis Williams shot 5 for 11, including 2 for 7 from beyond the arc to finish with 14 points, while adding six rebounds. It was the sixth win in a row for the Panthers. Jeremiah Davis finished with 20 points and five steals for the Bobcats (2-4). Cavin Holden added 18 points for Montana State. Jed Miller finished with 11 points, five assists and three steals. Up next High Point plays Tuesday against Duquesne, and Montana State hosts Northwest Indian on Wednesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.

articles.headline: South Dakota transfer Cameron Fens makes UNC debut in 88-72 win over Marshall
articles.description: Cameron Fens, a 7-foot South Dakota transfer who filed a lawsuit seeking to recover a year cut short by a misdiagnosed foot injury, and was granted a temporary restraining order, made his North Carolina debut, scoring nine points in a win over Marshall.
